Exam pattern (Advt 04/2022 official plan)

PaperQuestionsMarksTime
GK and current affairs, English, Punjabi, mental ability and maths1001002 hours
  • MCQ on an OMR sheet; 1/4 mark cut for each wrong answer; no penalty for a blank.
  • PSSSB papers advertised after October 2022 also have a qualifying matric-level Punjabi Part A, so expect it in any new VDO round.

Straight answers

Frequently asked questions

What is the VDO exam pattern?

100 MCQs, 100 marks, 2 hours, on an OMR sheet - GK 25, mental ability 25, maths 25, Punjabi 13 and English 12 - with 1/4 mark cut for each wrong answer.
